# HLT-C2 consistency proposal (A3, 17 November 2026)

Register decided under rules 1-4; checked against rules 1-13 (rule 11 revised). New rows are candidates; decisions in 00_consistency_proposal.json.

## Changes
1. Rule 11 (revised): C19 (abstract, p.1) and C20 (Conclusion, p.11) make the same assertion: the study showed positive outcomes of the service. The Discussion repeats it twice (p.10). New C21 lists all locations, empty rests_on (rule 2). Reject C19, C20, R11-R20; new R22-R26 (C21 covers C1-C5).
2. Rule 2 / rule 11 last clause: C14 summarises C8 and C9 without citing findings, but rests on F19;F20;F22;F24;F25. New C22 has an empty rests_on. Reject C14, R6, R7; new R27, R28 (C22 covers C8, C9). Joint count unchanged (C14 was Q only).
3. Rule 10: reject R21 (C19 backs C10), not re-anchored. In the basis (p.10, "shows very positive and promising outcomes [...] and moreover demonstrates the potential"), "moreover" only adds a point and does not mark an inference. In the abstract the two sentences only follow each other.

## Checked, no change
- Rule 6: C16 and C17 are statements about the literature, not recommendations for future research. The research-agenda sentences (p.10 "platform to allow other research", p.11 "future research may consider") were never registered.
- Rule 7: C10, C12, C15-C18 are not argued with this study's findings anywhere in the text. C10's p.10 support restates outcome claims, not findings.
- Rule 8: rests_on of C1-C9 holds. C7 stays F21 only.
- R9: "As an example" marks the link; it stays.
- C7 is already one row with both locations. Fit values are consistent.
